inlineContent.text: The HUMAN Security SDK works by constantly profiling and evaluating device behavior to ensure that the connections to your mobile APIs and services are genuine.

While the underlying process is complex, integrating the SDK is simple: you only need to initialize it. Once initialized, the SDK automatically manages secure HTTP headers that are added to all outgoing HTTP and HTTPS requests from your app to your backend server. These HTTP headers are refreshed on a regular basis by the SDK as it is profiling the end-user’s mobile device.
The SDK has support for the following products:
Bot Defender - Identifies and mitigates malicious bot activity.
Account Defender - Protects user accounts from takeover and abuse.
The SDK supports the following environments:
App based on Swift 5.5 and higher
App based on Kotlin 1.6.0 and higher

The SDK adds support to our products in your app.
The SDK has 2 objectives to achieve in order to support Bot Defender:
Provide HTTP Headers to your app’s URL requests.
Handle blocked requests and present a challenge to the user.
The SDK has 2 objectives to achieve in order to support Account Defender:
Notify HUMAN’s backend when a user is logged into the app.
Notify HUMAN’s backend on outgoing URL requests from the app.
The following are required to install the SDK:
Administrative access to the HUMAN Portal to:
Retrieve the HUMAN application ID (App ID).
Configure token expiration and validity settings in the HUMAN Portal.
